approach: Consistent pattern across engagements: assess current-state architecture, define/recommend a target state, identify gaps and impacted applications, and drive client discussions to translate business requirements into the technical solution. Explicitly named as "thought leadership" at the Fortune 50 semiconductor company (2015): exploring, investigating, recommending, benchmarking, and implementing technologies.
